integrity: Proof reconstructs an exact finite-block Gaussian minorization, absorption, and stationary-law classification. Standalone rational/numerical verification is supporting, not an infinite-time certificate.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uses independent Gaussian innovations applied only after an eligible contact, arbitrary finite positive utilities, finite population, strict confidence threshold, and unbounded real opinions. The general-population uniform lifetime bound is not sharp. The exact waiting-time formula requires two agents and half-compromise. Similar conditioned-noise theorems may occur in unindexed literature; independent validation not performed.
title: Almost-sure freezing and an exact rare-noise lifetime in utility-weighted bounded-confidence dynamics
